45:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Grrr!! I was going to cheer you up, $n, until just a moment ago, and now my anger has exploded all at once!」

45:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「At this rate, I'm the one who will end up drawing out the power of the $$スフィア$$!」

45:t_10:51.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That voice... Are you the pilot of the blue robot that backed me up?」

45:t_10:52.en:
$n
「Yeah, that's right. ...I'm $F. Nice to meet you.」

45:t_10:53.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm $$ガロード・ラン$$. Nice to meet you too.」

45:t_10:54.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Sorry, but I'm kind of busy right now. If you need something, keep it short.」

45:t_10:55.en:
$n
「I have something I want to ask about the weapon mounted on your $$ガンダム$$, the one called the $$サテライトキャノン$$.」

45:t_10:57.en:
$n
「If you'd used that, you could have wiped out the $$サイデリアル$$ forces. Why didn't you?」

45:t_10:58.en:
$$ガロード$$
「There was no need to use it, not against enemies of that level.」

45:t_10:60.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It's not like that. ...It's just that, if I can help it, I don't want to use the $$サテライトキャノン$$.」

45:t_10:61.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Having a weapon that's too powerful never leads to anything good.」

45:t_10:63.en:
$$ガロード$$
「There are times when you can't afford to talk pretty... But still, if I can help it, I don't want to use it.」

45:t_10:65.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It's fine. Your backup helped me out a lot.」

45:t_10:66.en:
$n
「If you're saying that, then it goes both ways.」

45:t_10:67.en:
$$ガロード$$
「See ya. Let's have a proper talk later.」

45:t_10:69.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's just like a $$スフィア$$, isn't it.」

45:t_10:71.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Those words from $$ガロード$$ seem to have left a strong mark on you.」

45:t_10:72.en:
$n
「...Hey, AG... Was the $$ジェニオン$$ built to steal the $$スフィア$$ of 《$$ジェミニア#keyword$$》?」

45:t_10:73.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I can't say for certain. But that is what I believe.」

45:t_10:74.en:
$n
「According to that guy $$ブルー$$, there are $$スフィア・リアクター$$s on this $$翠の地球$$...」

45:t_10:75.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. I hear Miss $$セツコ・オハラ$$, whom the $$ギルター$$ we fought today mentioned, is also a Reactor.」

45:t_10:76.en:
$n
「AG... Look into the $$スフィア$$ as much as you can.」

45:t_10:77.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood. But to draw out that power...」

45:t_10:79.en:
$n
「To draw out the power of the $$ジェニオン$$'s $$スフィア$$, the $$いがみ合う双子$$, conflicting human emotions have to act as the trigger...」

45:t_10:80.en:
$n
「I'll try. I don't know what to do right now, though...」

45:t_10:81.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I believe $n can surely master the $$スフィア$$ without being swept away by an overly powerful force.」

45:t_10:83.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, to lift our spirits, let's go! Another day of giving it my all...!」

45:t_10:84.en:
$n
「Sorry... That's the one thing I just can't bring myself to say.」

45:t_10:85.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Grrr!! I was going to cheer you up, $n, until just a moment ago, and now my anger has exploded all at once!」

45:t_10:86.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「At this rate, I'm the one who will end up drawing out the power of the $$スフィア$$!」

46:t_000:0.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「...Are you sure there's treasure sunk here?」

46:t_000:1.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「If you doubt it that much, why don't you dive down and see for yourself?」

46:t_000:2.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「C-cut it out... I... diving is...」

46:t_000:3.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Sorry. That joke went a little too far.」

46:t_000:5.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「The reason I went out of my way to bring you here is that it's the genuine article, so I figured I'd show you first of all.」

46:t_000:6.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You're probably going to dump some troublesome job on me anyway.」

46:t_000:7.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「...There's no telling what might happen. That's why I called on you too, the repairman.」

46:t_000:8.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Those guys... are they active around here?」

46:t_000:9.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Yeah. Until now they were only checking out the $$クジライカ$$ nest, but it looks like a large force is on the move.」

46:t_000:10.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「I've sent out scouts just in case. Depending on the situation, we're getting out of here fast.」

46:t_000:11.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Then what about the treasure?! You're not seriously going to leave it, are you?!」

46:t_000:12.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「You're noisy. Salvage or whatever, life comes first.」

46:t_000:13.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「If those guys have shown up, we have no choice but to pull back. That's the rule of this sea.」

46:t_000:14.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Tch... Nothing but trouble has happened since we got caught in that weird storm.」

46:t_000:15.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Even so, we're alive like this. We ought to be thankful for that.」

46:t_001:0.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Is that word from the scouts?」

46:t_001:1.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「This is bad, $$ピニオン$$! Pirates are coming!」

46:t_002:1.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Wait, $$ピニオン$$! Something's off!」

46:t_003:0.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What are those guys doing...?」

46:t_004:0.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「A ship, from inside the sea!?」

46:t_004:1.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「A sunken ship surfaced...!? No... that ship is moving through the water!」

46:t_004:2.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「If she were in perfect condition, we could go to a greater depth...」

46:t_004:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「She can't manage it in her current state.」

46:t_004:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We should be glad she didn't burn up, thanks to the hard work of the $$マクロス・クォーター$$.」

46:t_004:5.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「I was astonished. To use debris as a shield against the friction heat of the atmosphere, and at the same time support the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ from below.」

46:t_004:6.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Our boss's wave-riding skills are the best, aren't they, Lieutenant Colonel $$マデューカス$$?」

46:t_004:7.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Wave-riding on debris... I've come to truly appreciate the depth of space combat, Captain $$ジェフリー$$.」

46:t_004:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I am humbled by such undeserved praise. But first, let us get through this situation.」

46:t_004:9.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Judging from their equipment, I think they have nothing to do with the $$サイデリアル$$, but...」

46:t_004:10.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Most likely they are outlaws who claim this area as their territory.」

46:t_004:11.en:
$$ボビー$$
「I heard the frontier of the 《$$ＵＣＷ$$》 was in a state of anarchy, but it looks like $$翠の地球$$ is the same.」

46:t_004:12.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The green ocean... Is this place filled with battle too?」
